description: This file defines the implementation of Spark ML pipeline classes, including Pipeline, PipelineModel, and their associated read/write mechanisms. It manages stages of estimators and transformers, supports persistence, and facilitates pipeline execution within PySpark.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: A sequence of stages (estimators or transformers) that can be fit and transformed as a unit, supporting persistence and execution within PySpark.

classes.name: PipelineModel
classes.description: A fitted pipeline consisting of transformers and models, capable of transforming datasets and supporting persistence.

classes.name: PipelineSharedReadWrite
classes.description: Utility class providing shared functions for reading and writing Pipeline and PipelineModel stages, including validation, saving, and loading.

methods.name: setStages
methods.description: Sets the list of stages for the pipeline.

methods.name: getStages
methods.description: Retrieves the list of stages in the pipeline.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the pipeline, including stages.

methods.name: _fit
methods.description: Fits the pipeline to a dataset, executing stages in order and returning a PipelineModel.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the pipeline with optional extra parameters.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Returns an MLWriter for persisting the pipeline.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns an MLReader for loading a persisted pipeline.

methods.name: _from_java
methods.description: Creates a Python Pipeline object from a Java Pipeline object for persistence.

methods.name: _to_java
methods.description: Converts the Python Pipeline object to its Java counterpart for persistence.
